reuse.why: Instead of extracting the local link-clearing step of unlinkAccount into a helper that both paths share, it copies that step's field reset into the link check.

duplication.why: The updateAccount reset object (account_id, bank, balances, sync source, sync status set to null) is a verbatim copy of the one in unlinkAccount, so the meaning of an unlinked account now has two definitions.

placement.why: Threading the flag through the shared ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked reaches all six providers in one place, but putting a mutating unlink inside a function named as a precondition check muddles the layering.

scope.why: Mixes in unrelated Prettier reformatting of existing tests and of the DbAccount type union.

maintainability.why: A maintainer has to keep two copies of the unlink field reset in sync, and the 'ensure...IsNotLinked' name hides that the function can now modify another account.

bypasses_abstraction.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in accounts/app.ts clears the link with a direct db.updateAccount rather than going through unlinkAccount, or a local-only part split out of it, which the comment justifies.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied reset block from unlinkAccount is an open, verbatim copy, not a disguised one.
